posts.title: From Markdown to Carve
posts.description: "A practical migration: convert a Markdown file, inspect the few syntax changes that matter, and add linting before publishing." Trying a new markup language should not begin with retyping your archive. Carve has enough in common with Markdown that most of a document can move mechanically: headings, links, images, block quotes, code spans, fenced code,…
